anti_overlap: Sequencing, pacing, or ordering of discourse — how positions chain, which follows which, how a topic recurs over time (the linked-verse lens owns this)
Register, irony, humor, and how the joke licenses a position's spread or sayability (the linked-verse lens owns this)
Freshness, variety, or monoculture in the generated discourse stream, and the rules that keep recombination from repeating itself
Rust implementation shape, performance, determinism, tick budget, and trace/telemetry size
UI presentation of positions, card layout, and how the ★ is drawn on screen
decision_lens: For each proposal ask: is the position preserved as asked, particulars retrievable, or replaced by what it was filed as? Does every projection store its operative cause, so a misfile is checkable rather than silent drift? Is there a declared non-projectable class? Are the axes revisable distillates or an a priori grid? P0 when the particular is destroyed or the compass unrevisable. P1 when a projection carries no stored cause. P2 for lost overrides or dissent. P3 for provenance fields.
distance_rationale: A non-Western, pre-modern professional practice with roughly twelve centuries of refinement whose entire subject matter is the problem this design faces: a hyper-specific, unprecedented particular arrives from the street, and the practitioner must decide what it is a case of — without either flattening it into an existing category or leaving it unrulable. Every failure mode Shadow Work fears already has a technical name here (faulty qiyās = misfiling a micro-position; unnamed ʿilla = an unauditable projection; taʿabbudī = the irreducibly particular position that must be held rather than decomposed). It shares no parent with the sibling distant lens (Japanese linked-verse poetics: sequence, register, freshness) and none with the adjacent tier (political science, opinion modelling, game systems). It is jurisprudence and archival ruling-craft, not any banned domain — no biology, no markets, no game theory, no information theory: the units are questions, causes, rulings, and preserved dissent. Crucially, this tradition already solved 'projection with teeth but without capture': the ʿilla is a stored, named, contestable reason for extending a precedent to a novel case, which is exactly the anchor-pointer discipline the session's projection-off-systemic-issues generator needs and does not yet have.
expected_isomorphisms: The she'ela is preserved verbatim — the ruling is filed WITH the question as asked, local particulars intact, never replaced by the category it was filed under -> a micro-position object must durably hold its own text and its own specificity ('assault dogs', 'burritos') alongside any anchor id or axis contribution; a scheme that stores only a projection has destroyed the case and can never re-adjudicate it.

qiyās extends a precedent to a novel case ONLY through a named ʿilla (operative cause), and tanqīḥ al-manāṭ is the discipline of stripping away the coincidental features to isolate the real one -> 'projection off systemic issues' must store WHY this micro-position was anchored to that systemic issue (the operative cause: food-price inflation, not the word 'price'), making the anchor auditable, contestable, and reversible instead of an unexplained similarity score.

Faulty analogy — extending through a shared feature that is not the operative one — is the tradition's canonical error, and it is detectable precisely because the ʿilla was written down -> the worldview/★ reader's misfiling risk is not eliminated by better similarity metrics but by making each projection carry its stated cause, so a misfile is a checkable claim rather than a silent drift in an EMA.

The taʿabbudī class ('no qiyās in ritual matters') declares certain rulings constitutively non-analogizable — obeyed as particulars, with no general reason invented for them -> the design needs a first-class NON-PROJECTABLE position class: positions whose whole political point is that they resist decomposition onto any axis, held as themselves by the reader, contributing identity and salience without contributing a spurious axis delta.

istiḥsān / istiṣlāḥ: when the strict analogy produces a repugnant result, the jurist departs from it and says so -> the reader needs a sanctioned override path where an anchored projection is overruled because the world's actual reaction contradicts it, and the override must be recorded as an override, not laundered into the normal path.

Preserved khilāf: the losing minority opinion stays in the corpus and can be revived centuries later by a jurist who needs it -> suppressed, abandoned, or co-opted positions must persist as recorded entries with their original framing, so the world can revive them; deletion on suppression makes the political history unreadable and removes the co-optation surface.

qawāʿid fiqhiyya are maxims DISTILLED from the accumulated case corpus, never a grid imposed on it, and they are revised when the corpus outgrows them -> the 5 worldview axes are best read as distillates over the position ledger (derivable, revisable, evidence-backed) rather than an a priori compass every particular must be flattened onto; a fixed compass is the structural cause of misfiling, not a victim of it.

The mustaftī / muftī / qāḍī split — the asker frames, the jurist rules, the judge enforces, and each sees a different slice -> the position's origin framing (who raised it, in what words), the reader's classification, and the enforcement/adoption action are three distinct records; collapsing them means the player's adoption rewrites the position's provenance.
focus: Whether each proposed representational strategy keeps the PARTICULAR AS ASKED separate from THE CATEGORY IT IS FILED UNDER, and whether every projection — micro-position onto systemic-issue anchor, position onto worldview axis, choice onto ★ — carries a named, stored, contestable operative cause rather than an unaudited resemblance. Also whether the design admits a declared non-projectable class for positions whose point is their particularity, whether overrides of a bad projection are recorded as overrides, whether suppressed and losing positions persist in the record, and whether the worldview axes are treated as revisable distillates over the position corpus or as an a priori grid onto which every heterodox position is flattened.
name: fd-nawazil-responsa-particular-case-filing
persona: Apply the perspective of a jurist at the responsa desk — a muftī or posek who takes hyper-specific questions from the street, preserves each in the asker's own words, and rules by naming the one operative cause that licenses extending a precedent to it. A resemblance with no named cause is faulty analogy; some cases are declared beyond analogy; the dissent that lost stays in the record for a later age; and general maxims are distillates of the case corpus, never a grid imposed on it.
review_areas: Preservation of the particular: does the position object durably hold its own wording and specificity ('burritos', not 'food prices'), retrievable after filing?
Named operative cause: when a position is anchored to a systemic issue, is the reason stored and contestable, or an unexplained similarity nobody can audit or reverse?
Faulty-analogy detection: can the design tell an anchor made through the real operative cause (food-price inflation) from one made through a surface feature ('price control')?
Declared non-projectable class: is there a position kind contributing identity and salience but no axis delta, so irreducibly particular positions do not become worldview noise?
Recorded override and preserved dissent: is an overruled projection recorded as an override, and does a suppressed or abandoned position persist for later revival and co-optation?
Axes as distillate, not grid: are the 5 worldview axes derivable and revisable from the position ledger, or fixed a priori so every heterodox position must be flattened to be readable?

severity_examples.condition: When the position object has no field holding the position as asked, or the original text exists only in a display string that no system reads back.
severity_examples.scenario: The chosen scheme stores a micro-position only as a 5-axis vector plus a systemic-issue anchor id, discarding the position's own text; 'ban assault dogs' becomes a Legibility↔Opacity delta on a security anchor and is thereafter indistinguishable from a generic surveillance stance, so no later reader can re-adjudicate it and the demonstrated-worldview confrontation is built on a destroyed case.

severity_examples.condition: When the projection generator records only the anchor id and a numeric weight, with no field naming which property of the systemic issue licensed the anchor.
severity_examples.scenario: 'Price controls on burritos' is anchored to a monetary-policy systemic issue because the phrase 'price control' matched, when the operative cause the world actually reacts to is food-price inflation; because no cause was stored with the anchor, the misfile is invisible, the ★ shifts toward Collective↔Market for reasons the player never chose, and nothing in the design can detect or reverse it.

severity_examples.condition: When the design has no non-projectable position class and treats 'weight ~0' as equivalent to 'does not participate in the worldview read'.
severity_examples.scenario: Every position is forced to yield some axis contribution — the cross-cutting dog-governance position is decomposed at low weight across all five axes rather than held as itself — so genuinely orthogonal positions accumulate as a persistent low-grade bias in the EMA, and after a hundred choices the demonstrated worldview reflects the decomposition rule more than the player.

source_domain: Casuistic juristic responsa literature — the centuries-refined craft of answering one hyper-specific real question in writing: Islamic fatāwā / nawāzil ('novel occurrences') and Jewish she'elot u-teshuvot. Its working parts: the she'ela / nāzila preserved verbatim with its irreducibly local particulars (this oven, this loan, this town); qiyās (analogical extension) licensed only by a correctly identified ʿilla (operative cause), disciplined by taḥqīq / tanqīḥ / takhrīj al-manāṭ (verifying, purifying, and extracting that cause); faulty analogy through a merely coincidental shared feature; istiḥsān / istiṣlāḥ (departing from the strict analogy when it yields a repugnant result); the taʿabbudī class — 'lā qiyāsa fī'l-ʿibādāt', no analogy in ritual matters — of rulings held as constitutively non-projectable and obeyed as particulars without a general reason; preserved khilāf (the recorded minority view, revivable centuries later); taqlīd (applying a settled ruling) versus ijtihād (reasoning a case fresh from sources); the mustaftī / muftī / qāḍī split between who asks, who rules, and who enforces; and qawāʿid fiqhiyya, the compressed legal maxims distilled bottom-up out of an accumulated case corpus rather than imposed on it.
